browser: Playwright 1.63.0 Chromium, headless, 1440x1000, one browser context per identity

steps.action: Register step 1: open Entities; first view is Calendar; select List
steps.expected: Entities opens on Calendar; List shows the registry table.
steps.actual: Entities opened at /entities with the Compliance calendar heading. List moved to ?view=list and showed a table headed "Legal name Type Jurisdiction Registration no. Status Portal-listed Next obligation".

steps.action: Register step 2: Search entities by name, then Type/Status/Jurisdiction/Majority owner filters and Clear all
steps.expected: Search narrows by legal name; each filter exists and narrows; Clear all removes filters.
steps.actual: Search "Helix Software GmbH" left 1 row(s), all with that name. Type LLC plus Status Active left 13 of 50 rows, each LLC and Active. Clear all returned 50 rows and reset Type. Jurisdiction and Majority owner filters were present.

steps.action: Register steps 3-5: Add entity with identity details, Status default Active, Register, open the new Entity; creator Grant
steps.expected: Dialog titled Add entity; Status defaults to Active; Register saves the details; the adder holds a Grant.
steps.actual: The Add entity dialog opened with Status Active. Register saved "DOC-029 entities C31 L Aldoria Holdings 9U3SZ" and the record opened with {"Formation jurisdiction":"Republic of Aldoria","Formed on":"2019-03-14","Registration no.":"ALD-9U3SZ","Tax ID":"TX-9U3SZ","Registered agent":"Aldoria Corporate Agents","Registered address":"1 Harbour Row, Port Aldo"} and Status Active. The record offered Manage access, and its access list named Nadia Haddad (["Nadia Haddad"]).

steps.action: Register step 5: change one field and move focus away; a selection saves when chosen; both survive reload; Status Dormant does not archive
steps.expected: Registered agent saves on blur; Status Dormant saves on selection; no Archived mark; Archive still offered.
steps.actual: After a reload Registered agent read "Aldoria Registered Agents Ltd" and Status read Dormant. The record still offered Archive and no Restore, so the Dormant Status did not archive it.

steps.action: Names are not unique: registering the same legal name again creates another Entity
steps.expected: A second Register with the same name creates a distinct record; the first is not changed.
steps.actual: Searching the name listed 2 rows linking to 2 different records: ["DOC-029 entities C31 L Aldoria Holdings 9U3SZ Corporation Republic of Aldoria ALD-9U3SZ Dormant No —","DOC-029 entities C31 L Aldoria Holdings 9U3SZ LLC Duchy of Kessel — Active No —"]. The first kept Republic of Aldoria and Dormant.

steps.action: Negative: blank Legal name has a clear outcome
steps.expected: Register with no Legal name keeps the dialog open with the refusal message and creates nothing.
steps.actual: Register with an empty Legal name kept the dialog open and showed "Name the entity — its registered legal name.". The registry size stayed 50.

steps.action: Parties step 1: choose Our entity on a Contract; it survives reload
steps.expected: Our entity saves the chosen Entity.
steps.actual: C-62 Our entity read "DOC-029 entities C31 L Aldoria Holdings 9U3SZ" after a reload.

steps.action: Parties steps 2-3: type a new name and Create; the first Counterparty is Primary
steps.expected: Create adds the new Counterparty to the Contract with the Primary mark.
steps.actual: Create "DOC-029 entities Cedar Supply L 9U3SZ" added it. After a reload the Contract showed 1 Primary mark and its parties were ["DOC-029 entities Cedar Supply L 9U3SZ"] with "DOC-029 entities Cedar Supply L 9U3SZ" primary.

steps.action: Parties step 4: add another Counterparty and Make primary
steps.expected: Make primary moves the Primary mark to the chosen Counterparty.
steps.actual: After Make primary and a reload the Contract's primary Counterparty was "DOC-029 entities Birch Logistics L 9U3SZ"; parties ["DOC-029 entities Birch Logistics L 9U3SZ","DOC-029 entities Cedar Supply L 9U3SZ"].

steps.action: Picker negatives: an exact existing name in another case offers no Create; a Counterparty on the Contract is not offered again
steps.expected: No Create row for a case variant; the attached party is not listed.
steps.actual: Typing "DOC-029 ENTITIES CEDAR SUPPLY L 9U3SZ" listed ["No counterparties to add."]: no Create row, and DOC-029 entities Cedar Supply L 9U3SZ (already on the Contract) was not offered.

steps.action: Parties step 5: Take name off the contract; next remaining takes Primary; shared record remains; final removal leaves none
steps.expected: Removing the Primary passes the mark; removal does not delete the shared Counterparty; removing the last leaves no Counterparties.
steps.actual: Taking DOC-029 entities Birch Logistics L 9U3SZ off left ["DOC-029 entities Cedar Supply L 9U3SZ"] with DOC-029 entities Cedar Supply L 9U3SZ Primary. Typing "DOC-029 ENTITIES BIRCH LOGISTICS L 9U3SZ" offered the shared record and no Create row (["DOC-029 entities Birch Logistics L 9U3SZ"]). Taking DOC-029 entities Cedar Supply L 9U3SZ off showed "Nobody is recorded on the other side yet.".

steps.action: Recovery: an archived Entity is not offered for a new selection; the existing Contract keeps its reference
steps.expected: Archive the chosen Entity; Our entity keeps showing it on C-n; another Contract does not offer it.
steps.actual: With the first "DOC-029 entities C31 L Aldoria Holdings 9U3SZ" archived, C-62 still showed "DOC-029 entities C31 L Aldoria Holdings 9U3SZ" as Our entity. On C-63 Our entity offered 1 option with that name; its value was the live duplicate's ID, not the archived record's. The Entity was then restored.

steps.action: Officer note: Remove name deletes the Officer entry
steps.expected: The Officer is absent even with Show former.
